"""Launch one independent array-only auditor alongside original training."""
import os
import subprocess
import time
from pathlib import Path
import psutil
from train_directional_bank_trial import read,ref,save
from train_v43_quality_trial import live
repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V162-flat-target-anchor-v1'
assert live(read(root/'launch-v1.json')['owner'])
assert not (root/'training-mask-audit.claim').exists() and not (root/'mask-audit-launch-v1.json').exists()
with (root/'training-mask-audit-v1.log').open('x') as log:
 p=subprocess.Popen([str(repo/'.venv/bin/python'),str(repo/'.cache/audit-v162-training-masks-v1.py')],cwd=repo,
    env=dict(os.environ,PYTHONPATH='src:scripts',OMP_NUM_THREADS='1',OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS='1'),stdout=log,
    stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,start_new_session=True)
 owner={'pid':p.pid,'created':psutil.Process(p.pid).create_time()}
save(root/'mask-audit-launch-v1.json',{'status':'original-independent-mask-auditor-launched','owner':owner,
    'recorded_unix_UTC':time.time(),'auditor':ref(repo/'.cache/audit-v162-training-masks-v1.py'),
    'source':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),'new_neural_forwards':0})
print(owner)
